ns2:section.sectionText: A prerequisite of ACCY 312 or ACCY 505 or approval of department. Tax Practice Management – allows MAS/MSA students to serve as managers for the VITA program. NOTE: Priority will be given to students with previous VITA experience. Seniors are invited to apply with the endorsement of a faculty member. You must have departmental approval to register. Send your resume to vita@business.illinois.edu Students are required to log in and use Compass2g (compass2g.illinois.edu) in order to complete this course.
